column1: # The AKM the block kept referring to but never showed: the AK-74M entry says
# "black polymer where an AKM has wood" and its doctrine note turns on seeing
# a wooden AKM, with no card to learn one from.
# Earlier searching failed because it looked for "AK-47", where Commons has
# mostly weapon caches, racks and airsoft replicas. This is a museum studio
# photograph: one rifle, plain ground, muzzle right, matching the other cards.
